system.description:
You attempt to suppress strong emotions in up to 3 creatures who can see and hear you within range. You speak with a reverberating confidence that quells their fears, anger, and confusion. Up to 3 creatures you choose must make a charisma saving throw; A creature can choose to fail or Critically fail this saving throw if it wishes.

Success: Affected creature resists this jutsu’s effect.

Failure: Affected creature has all ranks of Demoralized or Charmed suppressed as they are, for the duration, no longer under the effects of these conditions. If this jutsu ends while they are still having these conditions, those condition effects resume.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but also affected creatures loses all hostile desires for the duration. If the target is attacked or damaged this jutsu’s effects immediately end on all affected creatures.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and select 1 additional creature.
